name: @post/e2e-pr-flows
description: T0410 required test "playwright pr flows": two flows of the seed project (docs/34) driven in real Chromium against the real stack — the routes cmd/api mounts in front of the real auth guard, over real PostgreSQL and real Gitea. Flow one is batch create → objects → push → open pull request → request review → three review submissions → merge, with the reviews submitted through the app's own review form; flow two is one scientific conflict that the merge refuses to settle until a human records keep_both on the conflicts page and the same merge then lands carrying it. Self-contained like tests/e2e-pulls: harness deps live in this directory's own npm project (its own lockfile), outside the pnpm workspace.
